in_marathi.name: Bipasa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Auspiciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bipasa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bipasa is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words 'bipas' meaning 'auspicious' and 'as' meaning 'goddess'. This name is associated with the goddess Shri, who is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and auspiciousness. The name Bipasa signifies the presence of blessings and good fortune in a person's life.
